definitions: To happen in a particular way, especially in a way that was not expected.
To be discovered or revealed to be.
To attend a public event or to come to a meeting.
To empty the contents of something, especially a pocket, bag, or drawer.
examples: The weather turned out to be perfect for the picnic.
He turned out to be a very talented musician.
A large crowd turned out for the concert.
The factory turns out thousands of units every week.
She turned out her pockets looking for her keys.
pastTenses: turned out (past simple), turned out (present perfect)
